Generated Compton scattering

Generate the two ||(e^-\gamma \to e^-\gamma||) amplitudes, form their Dirac adjoint with Idenso, and contract the physical spin sums shared with GammaLoop. Both diagrams and their interference are retained. This agrees with the full massive FeynCalc result. External ports come from the generated wavefunctions. The adjoint gets its own index names; the mass, charge, external momenta and invariants are real. Incoming spins are averaged and outgoing spins are summed.
